full_page.content:
1934, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 178 Cont.
Mar. 4th Thomas Thorton - 38 - T.B. Two yrs. down - promises to be for faithful if again able to be around ..... is enrolled perpetually To- Clyde Mccarthy - 44 - T.B. - tumor - cancer Mrs. Trombley - 29 - mother of 4 little boys - quite sick - doctors in doubt what may be the trouble .....
Wilfred Graveline - 32 - Frumbley's cousin - quarreled with his father three yrs. ago, left note wished never to see home again. Father also wished never to see son in this world. Boy in shack away in northern Canada saves two missionaries from freezing who assure him his father had forgiven him ... real prodigal son meeting ... last month returned - was seen lingering at the gate in zero weather hesitating to come in. On hearing W's name the Father in shirt sleeves rose from dinner and ran without coat to embrace him. Both wept. Now everything fine.
Page 179 Mar. 4th James Casey
Mrs. Tilly Olas - 40 - goiter operation expected now - has husband & little boy.
Mother (Mrs. Habe1) asks by letter if it be a sin to pray God to make an angel of only child -"if there is no cure for her" Child - 12 - injured at birth, is bright in some ways ..... "Will have one consolation, to know that B. is in God's keeping." i. e. if He takes her.
Joan Molloy - 10 - Mrs. Nowack - 33 - Fears misscarriage Grace McCartin - 24 - now to be operated on again Mrs. Mary Higne.
Frank Scanio - 40 - blind 35 mos. from piece of steel into it. C. Pfent - 27 - breaking Mother-drinking
Cyril Ryckebusch - 47 - leakage of Heart O.K.
